name: Kombucha Girl
look: Two side-by-side selfie video frames of a young woman with blonde hair pulled back, under a textured white ceiling. Left: she grimaces in disgust, nose scrunched and mouth turned down. Right: she raises her eyebrows and tilts her head, suddenly reconsidering.
use: Mixed feelings about something: instant disgust, then a reluctant maybe. The caption names the thing being tried or considered, and the two faces show the flip from no way to hmm, actually.
slots: the thing you're unsure about (caption above)
examples: Waking up at 5 a.m. to go running
Though I would get to see the sunrise
describe: woman tasting something and making a gross face then reconsidering
girl disgusted then unsure if she likes it
lady grimacing then raising her eyebrows
two faces of a woman trying a drink for the first time
blonde girl going from yuck to maybe
origin: A 2019 TikTok video in which a woman tries kombucha for the first time and can't decide whether she likes it.
